description: This file defines a utility function 'getSelectedRole' that retrieves the user's selected role from localStorage, returning 'admin', 'instructor', 'student', or an empty string if none is set or an error occurs.

methods.name: getSelectedRole()
methods.description: Retrieves the last selected role from localStorage, returns 'admin', 'instructor', 'student', or an empty string if the role isn't set or an error occurs.
